Still riding the high from last night ✨

Got to see entity["musical_artist","Two Feet","American singer-songwriter"] with my favorite alchemist and it was everything we needed and more. We kicked things off with an amazing dinner at entity["restaurant","Rolf and Daughters","Nashville, TN, USA"], then proceeded to paint the town red like we always do.

Ended the night dancing our butts off at the concert until they literally shut the place down. No better feeling.

But what I loved most about the night wasn’t just the music or the food. It was the reminder.

As women building, leading, and scaling businesses in a space that hasn’t always made room for us, we carry a lot. We’re decision makers, problem solvers, visionaries. We’re “on” all the time.

And sometimes… the most powerful thing we can do is take our power *back*.

Take the boss hat off.  
Stop optimizing.  
Stop leading.  
Stop holding it all together.

And just go be.

Dance. Laugh. Be loud. Be free. Be present.

Because success isn’t just what we’re building. It’s how we’re living.

Grateful for a night to unwind, reset, and share it with another strong, successful female entrepreneur who just gets it 🖤
